channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Cisco
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Cisco, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch now (update): Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software: Unchecked Return Value to NULL Pointer Dereference
item.description:
Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software: Denial of service · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 9.16.4.104, 9.18.4.96, 9.20.4.50 · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Update Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software to the fixed version for your release line (for example 9.16.4.104, 9.18.4.96 or 9.20.4.50).

Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-76418

item.title: Patch now: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller and Manager: Authentication Bypass
item.description:
Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller and Manager: Authentication bypass · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · fix: 20.9.8.2, 20.12.5.3, 20.15.4.2

First step: Update Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller and Manager to the fixed version for your release line (for example 20.9.8.2, 20.12.5.3 or 20.15.4.2).

Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller, formerly SD-WAN vSmart, and Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager, formerly SD-WAN vManage, contain an authentication bypass vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and obtain administrative privileges on an affected system. This vulnerability exists because the peering authentication mechanism in an affected system is not working properly. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending crafted requests to an affected system. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to log in to an affected Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller as an internal, high-privileged, non-root user account. Using this account, the attacker could access NETCONF, which would then allow the attacker to manipulate network configuration for the SD-WAN fabric.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-20127

item.title: Patch: Cisco Secure Email Gateway: Relative Path Traversal
item.description:
Cisco Secure Email Gateway: Path traversal (file read/write) · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · fix: 15.5.5-014, 16.5.0-780

First step: Update Cisco Secure Email Gateway to 15.5.5-014 or 16.5.0-780 or later.

Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-76519, CVE-2026-20353, CVE-2026-76440, CVE-2026-76441, CVE-2026-76442

item.title: Keep patched: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager: Hex Encoding
item.description:
Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager: exploited from day 0 · fix: 20.9.10.1, 20.12.8.2, 20.15.6.1

First step: Update Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager to the fixed version for your release line (for example 20.9.10.1, 20.12.8.2 or 20.15.6.1).

Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-76504

item.title: Keep patched: Cisco Identity Services Engine: Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs
item.description:
Cisco Identity Services Engine: exploited from day 0 · check vendor

First step: Follow the vendor advisory for Cisco Identity Services Engine: install the update or apply the mitigation it lists.

Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

Critical · Check vendor · CVE-2026-76460

item.title: Keep patched: Cisco Secure Email Gateway: SQL Injection
item.description:
Cisco Secure Email Gateway: SQL injection · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · fix: 15.5.5-014, 16.0.4-302, 16.5.0-780

First step: Update Cisco Secure Email Gateway to the fixed version for your release line (for example 15.5.5-014, 16.0.4-302 or 16.5.0-780).

Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-76461

item.title: Keep patched: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management: Firewall Management Center Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel
item.description:
Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management: Authentication bypass · internet-facing · exploited · check vendor

First step: Follow the vendor advisory for Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management: install the update or apply the mitigation it lists.

Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.

Critical · Check vendor · CVE-2026-20079
